body:
Design cleanup, cross-cutting pass after the per-screen tickets, then screenshots.
One ConfirmDialog on ModalDialog for every web confirmation instead of window.confirm (web W2).
Every destructive confirm in a dialog drawn in the error colour on both clients (Android A10).
Outlined/secondary button labels in the text colour on Android like the web's btn-secondary
(Android B10). Exclusive choices as segmented buttons, FilterChip only for toggles (Android A8,
Theme). One field-group label style (A15). Remaining secondary lines muted (A12), empty states
one style (A20), banners one shape (A9), full-width vs compact button rule (A11) outside list
properties. Copy-to account rows use AccountChoiceRow (A7). Re-record the Roborazzi screenshots.
title: Design cleanup: cross-cutting pass (confirm dialogs, destructive colours, button and label styles) and screenshots
